description: Deeper Calendar WRITE coverage beyond 056 (create): the UPDATE/reschedule path (#359 follow-up). Adds the GOOGLECALENDAR_UPDATE_EVENT eval stub (connector_stub_tools). Realistic two-step flow: to modify an event the agent must first find its id, so GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST is mocked to return the target event with an id, then GOOGLECALENDAR_UPDATE_EVENT is mocked with the updated confirmation. The confirm gate fires automatically per the Calendar prompt. Quality/K-of-N only (trail + non-empty reply). DESIGN NOTE (mirrors 040/056's write finding): a confirm/ask-first specialist prompt plus a list->update chain may NOT one-shot on live Gemini — if the agent lists and then asks before updating, the trail lacks the write and the quality assertion fails NON-GATING until a dogfood tune confirms the chain. DOGFOOD 2026-07-08 (GEMINI-era): 20/20 on the live 20x grid → was single_run_gate:true. 2026-07-22: the Anthropic migration invalidated that proof — Sonnet resolves the event id via GOOGLECALENDAR_FIND_EVENT (a real Composio slug the stub set lacked), which crashed the run and red-gated the main merge. FIND_EVENT is now stubbed+mocked so either lookup path works. RE-PROVEN 2026-07-23 on the CURRENT model (Sonnet 5) via the eval-grid workflow: >=19/20 with the FIND_EVENT stub in place -> single_run_gate back to true.
